architectureDecisions: Preserve the BB-060/061/062 boundary: packages/oracle receives parsed orders plus injected readers and preserves ordered requests/content/sourceRef/QA provenance; packages/agentic-system owns WorkOrder/Context schemas, artifact-manifest policy, durable workflow checkpoints, recovery and acceptance.

createManifestArtifactReader, createJsonArtifactManifestStore, createAcceptedBackendArtifactManifestPublisher and ApplicationArtifactManifest v1 remain in Agentic Application. They decorate artifactReader before pullQaArtifacts; moving them into Oracle would invert authority and is forbidden.

The durable continuation identity is the tuple already persisted in acceptedBackend: handoff (artifact ref/path, producer work-order, revision, acceptance decision), completionDecision and optional exact artifactManifestRef. The manifest ref is continuation provenance and an artifactRef, not a replacement for the underlying reader sourceRef.

Protected and direct modes remain explicitly distinct. No publisher means the checkpoint omits artifactManifestRef and existing direct artifactReader callers continue unchanged. Presence of artifactManifestRef requires artifactReader.forManifest(exactRef); absence of that capability fails closed and never downgrades to direct reads.

Preserve manifest migration compatibility already implemented by createJsonArtifactManifestStore: immutable APPLICATION_ARTIFACT_MANIFEST v1 refs remain content-addressed; legacy manifest-<digest>.json files remain readable; current publication-<identity>.json single-winner slots may reuse only semantically equivalent acceptance/payload receipts.

Fresh-process proof must reconstruct a new JSON Blackboard store/orchestrator, manifest store and manifest-aware reader from persisted filesystem state only. It must not reuse producer-side maps, manifest objects, reader instances or in-memory checkpoints.

Failure phase remains meaningful: publication failure before QA_PENDING persists backendRecoveryRequired=true and returns through Backend/Core recovery; protected read/identity/content failure after QA_PENDING blocks the same QA checkpoint without reopening Backend execution or losing the exact manifest ref.

Public compatibility remains the Application adapter: resolveBackendContext/resolveQaContext signatures and agentic-system index exports stay unchanged; @exharness/oracle exposes the two pull functions only. No compatibility shim is needed unless the BB-062 DONE receipt contradicts this seam.

Execution requires BB-062 DONE and verifies the full BB-060→062 delivered topology. A missing/renamed port, moved manifest boundary or altered direct/protected behavior is PLAN_INPUT_CONTRADICTION, not permission to redesign within BB-063.
implementationSlices: O41 — Require BB-062 DONE, load its delivery receipt/consolidated refs, and verify the exact pull ports, thin Application resolvers, direct-injection topology and Application-owned manifest decorator. Stop with PLAN_INPUT_CONTRADICTION on material mismatch.

O42 — Add oracle-durability-migration integration coverage through the public resolveQaContext path, pinning exact artifactReader arguments, returned sourceRef, APPLICATION_ARTIFACT provenance and the full ArtifactManifestError code/cause matrix after package extraction.

O43 — Prove protected fresh-process continuation end to end: persist Backend ACCEPT + exact manifestRef in JSON Blackboard, discard every producer/workflow/store instance, reconstruct new Blackboard/manifest/reader instances from filesystem state, scope forManifest(exactRef), complete QA and submit the same manifest/artifact refs.

O44 — Prove phase-correct failures and recovery: missing forManifest, missing/wrong manifest, producer/revision/acceptance/stored-revision/content drift block the same QA_PENDING checkpoint without Backend rerun; publication failure sets backendRecoveryRequired; orphan receipt recovery reuses the exact ref only for equivalent acceptance and conflicts on semantic drift.

O45 — Prove migration compatibility: direct mode omits artifactManifestRef and preserves existing callers/exports; legacy manifest-<digest>.json remains readable beside publication slots; manifest v1/ref/digest and sourceRef are not rewritten; architecture checks keep manifest/recovery imports out of packages/oracle.

O46 — Run Oracle unit/integration, durability, manifest, recovery, architecture and full Agentic regressions; update Living Oracle/Application docs with the exact delivered boundary and its ordinary-filesystem durability limit.

recoveryContract.conflict: Changed acceptance semantics or publication payload fails with ARTIFACT_MANIFEST_CONFLICT.
